items.title: Pulling a relative cycle into the image of the cycle-classes map by a completely decomposed proper cover
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file relative-cycles.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: 9 行陈述（46 行证明）、完全分解 proper 覆盖把相对循环拉入 cycle-classes 入像：Noetherian 归纳、分片粘合（作者脚注自带子概形视图内容）、generic flatness、U-admissible 吹胀平坦化、uniqueness-extension 认同拉回、补集归纳修复完全分解性。5 处引用全具名，脚注内容已随给，无 omit，干净收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-get-cycles (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1176-1184

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Argue by Noetherian induction on the base, glue along irreducible components and the closures of their complements where the induction hypothesis applies to both pieces and the disjoint union of the two completely decomposed proper covers is again completely decomposed with the flat subschemes viewed as subschemes of the combined pullback, then in the integral case write the generic fibre of the cycle as a combination of prime cycles, take closures in X, apply generic flatness to obtain an open of the base over which the closures are flat, use the blowing-up lemma for flatness to find an admissible blowing up on which the strict transforms are flat over the new base, and recognize the resulting family of cycle classes as the pullback by the uniqueness lemma for extensions agreeing at the generic point, finally repair the fact that the blowing up need not be completely decomposed by Noetherian induction on the complement of the open and taking the disjoint union of the two covers (source lines 1186-1231)
